lines.text: Nagy [esők] jönnek és elindulok, elmegyek innen messze
lines.english: Heavy rains are coming and I set off, I go far away from here
lines.note: esők: Plural 'esők' represents heavy, persistent seasonal rains.

lines.english: On Route 67 you can wait for me shivering
lines.note: -hat/-het: Potential suffix indicating possibility ('várhatsz' = you may wait).

lines.text: Nyáréjszakán, ha nem jövök, esik az eső és [mennydörög]
lines.english: On a summer night, if I don't come, rain falls and thunder rolls

lines.text: A csillagokkal, ha szédülök, esik az eső és nem találsz rám
lines.english: With the stars, if I grow dizzy, rain falls and you won't find me
Stars, stars, tell me
lines.note: felszólító mód: Subjunctive/imperative definite conjugation with preverb 'el'.

lines.text: Merre jár, hol lehet most a [kedvesem]
lines.english: Which way is she wandering, where might my darling be now

lines.text: Veszélyes út, amin jársz, veszélyes [út], amin járok
lines.english: Dangerous is the road you walk, dangerous is the road I walk

lines.text: Egyszer te is hazatalálsz, egyszer én is hazatalálok
lines.english: One day you too will find your way home, one day I too will find my way home
lines.note: hazatalál: Compound verb with directional preverb 'haza' (find one's way home).

lines.text: Nagy esők jönnek és itt [maradok], itt maradok örökre
lines.english: Heavy rains are coming and here I remain, here I remain forever
Beside Route 67 sitting upon the ditch bank
lines.note: -va/-ve: Adverbial participle denoting simultaneous state ('ülve' = while sitting).

lines.text: Nyáréjszakán, ha nem jövök, esik az [eső] és mennydörög
lines.english: On a summer night, if I don't come, rain falls and thunder rolls

lines.text: A csillagokkal, ha szédülök, esik az eső és nem találsz rám
lines.english: With the stars, if I grow dizzy, rain falls and you won't find me
Stars, stars, tell me

lines.text: Merre jár, hol [lehet] most a kedvesem
lines.english: Which way is she wandering, where might my darling be now

lines.text: Veszélyes út, amin [jársz], veszélyes út, amin járok
lines.english: Dangerous is the road you walk, dangerous is the road I walk

lines.text: Egyszer te is hazatalálsz, egyszer én is hazatalálok
lines.english: One day you too will find your way home, one day I too will find my way home

lines.text: Nem jöttél túl [korán], de időm az volt
lines.english: You did not come too early, but time I had plenty of
It became a great pal of mine, and we sat in buffets
lines.note: koma: Traditional Hungarian term for godparent or sworn friend; personified here as time itself ('idő komám').

lines.english: Waiting for you, slapping each other's backs

lines.text: Italokat küldve múltját sem sejtő kékruhás nőknek
lines.english: Sending drinks to women in blue dresses who knew nothing of their own past
Stay at home, watch TV
Pitch-black trains are shown on every channel
lines.note: töksötét: Colloquial intensifier ('tök-' = pitch dark).

lines.english: They run, passenger there isn't a single one

lines.text: Csak a büfékocsiban állnak részegen, ketten
lines.english: Only in the buffet car two people stand drunk
The one feeling unwell, that's me
Pity that they show me right now
Just moments ago I was praising God
lines.note: az elébb: Archaic/dialectal colloquial for 'an instant ago / a moment earlier'.

lines.english: Drunk
In the evening you were a star, in daytime a swallow
lines.note: metaphor: Poetic folk contrast between an evening guiding light (star) and a fleeting migratory bird of day (swallow).

lines.english: Every field sown, every woman taken care of
Well, this is what I leave here for you
You star or swallow
I have never misunderstood a friendship
lines.note: félreért: Compound verb with preverb 'félre-' meaning to misunderstand.

lines.english: I have never drawn a lesson from it
lines.note: tanulságot von: Idiom meaning 'to draw a lesson / moral'.

lines.text: Én még sohasem tudtam kezelni a [távolságot]
lines.english: I could never handle the distance
No, no, certainly not I!
I have never grown bored of company
lines.note: megun: Verbal prefix 'meg-' completing the action of becoming bored with something.

lines.english: I have never cosmetically glossed over truth

lines.text: Én még sohasem, sose mondtam, hogy na [látod]
lines.english: I have never, ever said: well, you see!
lines.note: na látod: Conversational discourse marker meaning 'you see! / told you so!'.

lines.english: No, no, certainly not I!

lines.text: Ugyan már, sose mondtam, hogy ne [beszéljünk]
lines.english: Come on now, I never said we shouldn't talk
I never even messaged you
lines.note: ráír valakire: Modern digital colloquialism meaning 'to message / text someone'.

lines.text: Én még sohasem találtam magamat magam [alatt]
lines.english: I have never found myself down in the dumps
lines.note: maga alatt van: Common Hungarian idiom meaning 'to be down in the dumps / depressed'.

lines.english: Grief has never struck me

lines.text: Soha senki miatt nem olvasgattam a váróteremben a [horoszkópomat]
lines.english: Never because of anyone did I browse my horoscope in the waiting room
lines.note: olvasgat: Frequentative suffix '-gat/-get' indicating browsing or reading idly.

lines.text: Sose gondoltam arra, hogy többet nem [gondolok] rád
lines.english: I never thought of not thinking about you anymore
I have never lied an ugly truth
No, no, certainly not I!
Once the Sun grew so tired
lines.note: Nap: Capitalized in mythic poetic contexts denoting the sun.

lines.english: It retired to sleep upon the deep green lake
lines.note: aludni tért: Literary idiom meaning 'retired to sleep'.

lines.english: The darkness hurt the people
lines.note: dative: 'embereknek fájt' indicates pain caused to the people.

lines.english: She took pity on us, she came among us
lines.note: közénk: Illative personal pronoun meaning 'in among us'.

lines.english: Yes, there came a pearl-haired girl
lines.note: gyöngyhajú: Compound adjective from 'gyöngy' (pearl) + 'hajú' (-haired).

lines.english: Did I dream it, or is it perhaps true
Thus the earth became
Blue and green once again
Dawn arose, and she went home
lines.note: hajnal kelt: Poetic expression for daybreak.

lines.english: She disappeared behind blue stars
lines.note: mögé: Directional postposition meaning 'to behind'.

lines.english: The pearl-haired girl sleeps on
Quietly she lives in the depths of the sea
When you are very much alone
lines.note: egyedül: Adverb meaning 'alone / by oneself'.

lines.english: A star falls down from the sky
lines.note: -ból/-ből: Elative case suffix indicating movement out of something.

lines.english: The pearl-haired girl stands beside you
lines.note: melléd: Directional personal pronoun meaning 'beside you'.

lines.text: S a sötét éjben ő kísér
lines.english: And in the dark night she accompanies you

lines.text: Ha az életben nincs már több [móka]
lines.english: If in life there is no longer any fun
lines.note: móka: Colloquial Hungarian for fun, jest, amusement.

lines.english: We die, as if there were not
lines.note: volna: Conditional auxiliary used after 'mintha' (as if there were not).

lines.english: Any more things for us to do in the world
And death would be sweet
Well, in that sense
Let us sing that it's over
We will no longer go out to the meadow
We won't swim at the beach anymore

lines.text: És nem [borozunk] már többet a gangon
lines.english: And we won't drink wine on the corridor balcony anymore
lines.note: gang: Traditional courtyard balcony/corridor in classic Budapest apartment buildings.

lines.text: Nem süt a [nap] be az ágyba
lines.english: The sun won't shine into the bed
Like into that Athens hotel room

lines.text: És a viccek se lesznek már
lines.english: And the jokes won't be either
The laughter too grows shorter
Just as life wouldn't
Be wanted anymore after death
lines.note: kéne: Colloquial conditional form of 'kellene' (would be needed / wanted).

lines.english: For me, truly

lines.text: Miénk itt a tér, mert mi [nőttünk] itt fel
lines.english: The square here is ours, because we grew up here
lines.note: felnő: Compound verb with preverb 'fel' meaning to grow up.

lines.text: A ház is a miénk, mert mi [viseljük] el
lines.english: The building too is ours, because we are the ones who endure it
lines.note: elvisel: Idiom meaning 'to endure / to bear'.

lines.text: Nekünk kevés [fény] jut, árnyékból van több
lines.english: Little light falls to our share, of shadows there is more

lines.text: Sötét szobánkban a pók rossz hálót köt
lines.english: In our dark room the spider weaves a bad web
In the deep courtyards only ailanthus (tree of heaven) grows
lines.note: ecetfa: Tree of heaven, hardy urban tree characteristic of old inner-city Budapest tenements.

lines.text: A lépcsőn, melyen járunk, elkopott a [kő]
lines.english: On the stairway upon which we walk, the stone has worn down

lines.text: Miénk itt a tér, mert mi nőttünk itt fel
lines.english: The square here is ours, because we grew up here
Familiar is the whistle, and answers back to one another
We have roamed around many times in the afternoon
lines.note: csavarog: To wander, roam the streets aimlessly.

lines.english: Across manicured gardens, where summer lay reclined

lines.text: És ha este lett és indultunk [haza]
lines.english: And when evening came and we headed home

lines.text: Visszafogadott minket ott a tér dala
lines.english: The song of the square welcomed us back there
The square here is ours
The square here is ours

lines.text: A lépcsőn, melyen járunk, elkopott a [kő]
lines.english: On the stairway upon which we walk, the stone has worn down
The square here is ours

lines.text: Azt hiszed, hogy nyílik még a sárga [rózsa]
lines.english: You think that the yellow rose still blooms
lines.note: sárga rózsa: Historic metaphor for broken faith and unfulfilled promises in Hungarian folk and beat music.

lines.text: Azt hiszed, hogy hallgatunk a hazug [szóra]
lines.english: You think that we listen to lying words
You think that we always forgive everything

lines.text: Azt hiszed, hogy megtagadjuk minden álmunk
lines.english: You think that we deny all our dreams

lines.text: Virágok közt veled lenni, tudom, [szép] volna, kedvesem
lines.english: To be with you among flowers, I know, would be lovely, my darling
lines.note: volna: Conditional 'would be nice'.

lines.text: Virág sincsen, te sem vagy már, miért hagytuk, hogy [így] legyen?
lines.english: There are no flowers either, nor are you here anymore, why did we let it be like this?

lines.text: Virágok közt veled lenni, tudom, szép volna, [kedvesem]
lines.english: To be with you among flowers, I know, would be lovely, my darling

lines.text: Virág sincsen, te sem vagy már, nem ad választ senki sem
lines.english: There are no flowers either, nor are you here anymore, nobody gives an answer

lines.text: El ne hidd, ha bárki mondja, hogy ez [jó] így
lines.english: Do not believe it if anyone says that it is good this way
lines.note: el ne hidd: Negative imperative with preverb 'el' meaning 'don't you believe it'.

lines.text: El ne hidd, hogy minden [rendben], bárki szédít
lines.english: Do not believe that everything is in order, no matter who leads you on

lines.text: El ne hidd, hogy megváltoztunk vezény-[szóra]
lines.english: Do not believe that we have changed at a word of command
lines.note: vezényszó: Word of command / drill order.

lines.text: El ne hidd, hogy nyílik még a sárga rózsa
lines.english: Do not believe that the yellow rose still blooms

lines.text: Virágok közt veled lenni, tudom, szép volna, kedvesem
lines.english: To be with you among flowers, I know, would be lovely, my darling

lines.text: Virág sincsen, te sem vagy már, miért hagytuk, hogy [így] legyen?
lines.english: There are no flowers either, nor are you here anymore, why did we let it be like this?

lines.text: Virág sincsen, te sem vagy már, nem ad [választ] senki sem
lines.english: There are no flowers either, nor are you here anymore, nobody gives an answer
Why did we let it be like this?
Right now it is passing away precisely
lines.note: múlik: Expresses time or grief passing away at this very moment.

lines.english: I let it, let it go
lines.note: hadd + subjunctive: Permissive particle ('let it go').

lines.english: Let it run outward out of me
I thought, my only one
You are not in a good place here
You are not suited for me
lines.note: nem való nekem: Idiom meaning 'you are not suited for me'.

lines.english: Lightning strikes, thunder rolls
This really is love
I see that a bird swoops past above me
lines.note: elsuhan: Preverb 'el-' with verb of fleeting swooping flight.

lines.english: In its gaping heart barbed wire, in its beak a stalk of straw

lines.text: Magamat [ringatom], míg ő landol egy almafán
lines.english: I rock myself, while it lands upon an apple tree

lines.text: Az Isten kertjében almabort int a halál
lines.english: In the garden of God death signals cider
I would gallop on with you in the night
lines.note: vágtatnék: Conditional form of 'vágtat' (to gallop).

lines.english: On the spotted Indian horse of dreams
With a magical shaman heart in the kitchen knife
lines.note: táltos: Mythological shaman/magical steed in ancient Hungarian folklore.

lines.english: Under my soles mud and quagmire

lines.text: Olyan ő, hogy megáll a szívem, [kalapál], mégis olyan ember
lines.english: She is such that my heart stops, hammers, yet she is that kind of person
lines.note: kalapál: Onomatopoeic verb for a pounding heart ('hammers / throbs').

lines.text: Hogyha kell, odébb áll, ő az úton merre jár, abban nincsen [rendszer]
lines.english: If need be, she walks away; which way she wanders on the road, in that there is no system

lines.text: Kimerít, makacs és [szemérmetlen] is, én vele nem beszélek
lines.english: She exhausts me, stubborn and unblushing too, I won't speak with her

lines.text: Hogyha kellek, ölelj át, add a szíved, add a szád és én utolérlek
lines.english: If you want me, embrace me, give your heart, give your lips and I'll catch up with you
Look, this feeling is different!
You want it too, don't you?
lines.note: ugye: Conversational tag seeking agreement ('isn't that so? / right?').

lines.english: This disturbance of order is now so sweet
lines.note: rendbontás: Compound noun from 'rend' (order) + 'bontás' (breaking/disturbance).

lines.text: Hogy egy élet kevés lenne rá
lines.english: That a whole lifetime would be too little for it

lines.text: Csak a baj, csak a bú, de ma senki [szomorú] nincsen körülöttem
lines.english: Only trouble, only sorrow, but today no one is sad around me
lines.note: bú: Archaic/folk noun for melancholy sorrow.

lines.text: Csak te lépkedsz fel-alá, ezt tedd ide, azt meg rá, gyere ide [szépen]
lines.english: Only you pace up and down, put this here, and that on it, come here nicely

lines.text: Jönnék én, ha te lennél az, kit nékem fújt a [szél]
lines.english: I would come if you were the one whom the wind blew to me

lines.text: Inkább itt megvárom, míg a kezed táncra kér
lines.english: Rather I will wait here until your hand asks me to dance

lines.text: És e tánchoz [hű] legyél, és én veled járom
lines.english: And to this dance be faithful, and I will dance it with you
She makes my head spin, only plays with me
lines.note: szédít: Causative verb meaning 'makes my head spin / dazzles me'.

lines.text: Szédít, játsszál még nekem s én [kiheverem]
lines.english: She makes my head spin; play for me some more and I'll get over it
lines.note: kihever: Idiom meaning 'to get over / recover from' an illness or heartbreak.

lines.english: Look, this feeling is different!
Something is in the air
Something that puts you together at night
lines.note: összerak: Preverb 'össze-' (together) + 'rak' (put) = puts together / assembles.

lines.text: Van valami a levegőben, valami, ami reggel [szétszed]
lines.english: There is something in the air, something that takes you apart in the morning
lines.note: szétszed: Preverb 'szét-' (apart) = takes apart / dismantles.

lines.text: Valami van a levegőben, valami, ami éjjel összerak
lines.english: Something is in the air, something that puts you together at night
Leaving at two o'clock? As if! / No way!
lines.note: na még mit nem!: Common Hungarian sarcastic idiom meaning 'no way! / as if!'.

lines.english: Leaving at three o'clock? As if! / No way!

lines.text: Négykor ma elindulni? Na még mit nem!
lines.english: Leaving at four o'clock today? As if! / No way!

lines.text: Nélküled elindulni? Na még mit nem!
lines.english: Leaving without you? As if! / No way!
I'll rest when I'm old

lines.text: Majd ha gyógyszert szedek, majd ha [elköltözök]
lines.english: When I take medicine, when I move away
To a nursing home and we play cards in dressing gowns in secret

lines.text: De most látnod kell, hogy a világ csodás
lines.english: But right now you must see that the world is wonderful
Leave the internet behind you today
lines.note: a net: Colloquial abbreviation for the internet.

lines.english: Things are happening all around you

lines.text: Valami van a levegőben, valami, ami éjjel [összerak]
lines.english: Something is in the air, something that puts you together at night

lines.text: Van valami a levegőben, valami, ami reggel szétszed
lines.english: There is something in the air, something that takes you apart in the morning
